configuration.scrollTrace: 12 CSS pixels/frame; distant jumps every 30 requested frames; commands before frame timer
configuration.fonts: Two copies of bundled Barlow: ASCII primary and Latin-1 fallback

measurementNotes.cpuFrameMs: Elapsed around ui.frame(); includes Yoga, paint, input mirror, GL submission and synchronous virtual-window React commits. Excludes GPU execution and React commits scheduled outside frame().
measurementNotes.renderToCommitMs: Wall-clock scheduling latency through useLayoutEffect; not isolated React CPU time.
measurementNotes.frameIntervalMs: requestAnimationFrame timestamp intervals; includes browser scheduling and intervening work, not GPU timings or presentation confirmation.
measurementNotes.memory: No heap, browser-process or GPU-memory measurement is acquired by this harness.
measurementNotes.lifecycle: Remaining accessibility surfaces only; zero mirrors does not prove absence of leaks.
